notes.title: Current Work & Todo List
notes.content:
[h3]Additional Content[/h3]

We continue "shooting" Tanya's movie and next are the scenes with Vanessa and Wendy, including Tanya.

After that come scenes with Angela, then a scene with Barbara, a new scene with Gabrielle that also includes Claudia...

You can expect the game to be updated when the next 5-6 scenes are finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699536/c08a8bd925a4b158c0b74a7b3b07bcabc96ca679.jpg[/img]

[h3]TODO List[/h3]
[list]
[*] Finish all scenes for Tanya's movie
[*] Add the ability to view the entire movie
[*] Add new location: Tanya's night club (for Private Dance option)
[*] Add new pairs:
[list]
[*] Priya and Bruno (Premium Massage)
[*] Amy and Mike (Premium Massage)
[*] Richard and Irene (Room Service)
[*] Gordon and Violet (Room Service)
[*] David and Farrah (Private Dance)
[*] Mario and Haley (Private Dance)
[/list][/list]
Note 1: Richard (photographer and main cameraman), David and Mario (support staff on set) get extra money for every scene they shoot. They also have the option to request an advance payment from Tanya.

Note 2: Gordon (photographer for PlayStar magazine) and his assistant Amy, since they are employees of Tanya Entertainment, have the possibility to request an advance payment from Tanya.

After that comes the preparations for Episode 4, in which there will be a lot of changes and novelties. The main part of the story of Episode 4 will be related to the completion of the shooting of Tanya's film as well as the premiere of it (you will love the premiere of the film). 

The expansion of the business along with the additional income also brings new problems that Sophia will have to deal with. There will also be certain problems in the relationship between Sophia - Hana - Brigitte, but we will talk about that later (I can't tell you everything that will be in Episode 4 right now - something has to remain as a surprise).

For now, I can tell you that in Episode 4 some more locations will be added, as well as the possibility of additional earnings for Customers (poker room, escort option, etc.), but for now, Customers are limited to earning in RLD.

notes.title: The Player w. Tara
notes.content:
In addition to the main story and additional tasks for staff members, there is also a mini-game for ingame [i]Customers[/i]. We have added the possibility for the Player to go for a massage (Regular or Premium), and the girl who will meet him is Tara.
